# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Sound the Trumpet! The Exiles Return to Zion

---

**11:1** Sound the trumpet in Zion — the holy trumpet!
Shout across Jerusalem: the herald of good news has come!

**11:2** For God has shown Israel mercy —
he has come to visit them!

**11:3** Rise up to a high place, O Jerusalem, and see your children —
gathered from east to west at the word of the LORD!

**11:4** From the north they come, gathered by God;
from the distant islands God has called them home.

**11:5** He has leveled the mountains to flat ground before them;
the hills have scattered from their path.

**11:6** The forests have spread shade over them as they marched;
God caused every fragrant tree to spring up for them

**11:7** so that Israel could walk in the glory of God.
Dress yourself in your glory, O Jerusalem — put on your holy robes!

**11:8** Wrap yourself in your sacred vestments, O Jerusalem —
for God has spoken good things over Israel forever and ever!

**11:9** Let the LORD do everything he has spoken over Israel and Jerusalem;
may the LORD lift up Israel in the glory of his name!

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance. Sense-for-sense.*
